name: ButtonGroup
description: A button group shows related buttons together, spaced or attached into one control. With a value it becomes a segmented control where exactly one button is pressed, such as a list/grid view switcher.
whenToUse: For two to five related actions, e.g. Previous / Next or Bold / Italic / Underline.
For switching between a few views or modes of the same content (segmented).

whenNotToUse.text: To switch between panels of content.
To pick a value for a form.

anatomy.name: Buttons
anatomy.description: Regular Buttons; the pressed one is filled in segmented mode.

values.meaning: Joined into one control; inner corners squared.

states.name: Pressed
states.meaning: Segmented: the selected button is filled and aria-pressed.

states.name: Button states
states.meaning: Hover, focus and disabled come from Button.

behavior.text: Give each Button a value and the group a value/defaultValue or onValueChange. Clicking a button presses it and releases the others.
Every button is a Tab stop; in attached groups the focus ring stays above neighbours.

content: Use short, parallel labels, or icons with aria-labels (IconButton).

guidelines.dont: Put Save and Delete in one attached group.
guidelines.why: Attached buttons read as one control; a destructive action needs space.

guidelines.dont: Leave a group of icon buttons unnamed.
guidelines.why: The name tells screen reader users what the buttons control.

guidelines.do: Use Tabs to switch content panels.
guidelines.dont: Use a segmented group to replace tabs.
guidelines.why: Tabs have panel semantics and arrow-key navigation.

accessibility.role: group of buttons; segmented buttons are toggle buttons (aria-pressed).
accessibility.focus: Each button shows its focus ring.

wcag.how: Pressed is filled vs outlined, not a color change alone.

examples.title: Spaced
examples.code:
import { ButtonGroup, Button } from '@ds/react';

<ButtonGroup aria-label="Pages">
  <Button appearance="outline" variant="secondary">Previous</Button>
  <Button appearance="outline" variant="secondary">Next</Button>
</ButtonGroup>

examples.title: Attached
examples.code:
import { ButtonGroup, Button } from '@ds/react';

<ButtonGroup aria-label="Zoom" attached>
  <Button appearance="outline">−</Button>
  <Button appearance="outline">100%</Button>
  <Button appearance="outline">+</Button>
</ButtonGroup>

examples.title: Segmented
examples.description: One pressed button switches the view.
examples.code:
import { ButtonGroup, Button } from '@ds/react';

<ButtonGroup aria-label="View" attached value={view} onValueChange={setView}>
  <Button value="list">List</Button>
  <Button value="grid">Grid</Button>
</ButtonGroup>

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.description:
Related buttons shown together, spaced or attached. With a value, it becomes a segmented
control where one button is pressed, e.g. a view switcher.

aria-label.description: Names the group for screen readers, e.g. "Text alignment".

attached.description: Joins the buttons into one control instead of spacing them.

value.description:
Segmented selection: the Button whose `value` matches is pressed (filled); the others are
outlined. Controlled; use with onValueChange.

defaultValue.description: Initially pressed value for segmented selection, uncontrolled.

onValueChange.description: Called with the value of the pressed Button. Turns on segmented selection.
